item.title: M1 — AI agent fundamentals
item.author: alex@girard-davila.net (Alexandre Girard Davila)
item.description:
• Objectives: understand what an AI agent actually does (plan, call tools, iterate until validated) and where it fails; distinguish chatbot, assisted tool and autonomous agent; choose the right level of automation for a given use case.
  • Audience: managers, project leads, decision makers; no technical prerequisites (demos are live, not video).
  • Prerequisites: a laptop for the hands-on part (30 min of guided practice).
  • Deliverables / measurable outcomes:
    • every participant leaves with 3 candidate automations identified in their own workflows (use-case sheet provided);
    • short comprehension test (10-question quiz) — target ≥ 8/10;
    • an argued decision: “let’s talk it over” vs. “let’s move to M2/M3”.
